prompt: A wide medieval battlefield at dusk where five armored soldiers in dented steel plate, spread across the full width of the frame, are all simultaneously annihilated by a colossal vertical shaft of radiant white-gold holy light slamming down from a parted storm sky. Each soldier is caught mid-collapse, dissolving into the searing column, their silhouettes burning away to ash and bone. The blinding pillar of divine judgment splits the dark field down the middle. The background is a churning bruise-purple sky cracked open above, with the only source of light being the lethal white-gold column.

A towering radiant angel in bone-white robes and golden plate hovers at the center of a wide battlefield, both glowing arms outstretched, having just unleashed a divine reckoning. On her left, three armored knights crumble to drifting ash; on her right, three monstrous beasts dissolve to skeletons in the same blast of white-gold light. All six victims are fully visible, the same scale, collapsing simultaneously. The background is a dim ash-grey battlefield at dawn, the only strong light radiating outward from the angel.

A low wide ground-level view across a battlefield in the instant a wave of blinding white-gold holy radiance sweeps across it. A row of armored combatants spans the full width of the frame: those on the left are still solid steel-plated knights, those toward the right are already mid-disintegration, reduced to glowing skeletons and drifting ash as the shockwave reaches them. The expanding ring of white light is the only bright source. The background is a dim slate-grey dawn sky over a cracked muddy battlefield strewn with dropped weapons.

Three large armored knights in dented steel plate stand across a battlefield, all three fully visible and the same size, each caught mid-disintegration as a vertical column of searing white-gold holy light pours down from above and burns them away from the head downward into ash and exposed bone. Their dropped swords scatter at their feet. The descending pillar of divine judgment dominates the center. The background is a dark cracked-open dusk sky, the only source of light the lethal white-gold column consuming the three knights.

A colossal radiant hand made of white-gold holy light reaches down from a parted golden sky and presses flat across a wide battlefield, and beneath its glowing palm a whole crowd of tiny armored soldiers and beasts is crushed and burned to ash all at once, dozens of small dark silhouettes scattering and dissolving under the light. The giant luminous hand fills the upper half of the frame. The background is a vast dim battlefield seen from a high angle at dusk, the palm of light the brightest thing in the scene.

A wide battlefield split by a jagged chasm of blinding white-gold holy light tearing across the ground from left to right, and a ring of armored creatures and knights standing around the rift are all toppling and crumbling into it, their bodies catching fire and breaking apart, several distinct figures falling inward at once. The radiant fissure is the only light source. The background is a dark ash-strewn battlefield under a bruised twilight sky, smoke rising along the horizon.

Enormous glowing white-gold scales of divine judgment hang over a wide battlefield at dusk, the balance tipping hard to one side, and beneath each brass pan a row of armored soldiers is being seared to ash and bone by descending beams of holy light, multiple small dark figures collapsing on both sides at once. The giant luminous scales dominate the upper frame. The background is a dim slate battlefield under a cracked golden sky, the scales and their beams the only bright light.

The giant luminous scales dominate the upper frame. The background is a dim slate battlefield under a cracked golden sky, the scales and their beams the only bright light.
